objectives.summary: Esty aims to provide a safe and genuine space for users to discover meaningful love, emphasizing deep compatibility based on values, dreams, and passions. The project seeks to transform traditional dating methods by fostering genuine connections and prioritizing quality over quantity in matchmaking. The funding goal is set at $48,723, with a funding period from January 19, 2025, to March 20, 2025.
